title: Zoot Sims as a person
summary: He calls Zoot a gentle, great musician and friend.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Let's talk about Zoot for a while. Zoot is one of the very special people in this jazz world.
He's one of the special people in the world. He's a beautiful human being, kind, gentle, good, soft, unassuming, a
gentleman and a great musician; a good friend. I don't know anything negative about Zoot. I couldn't say one bad thing about him.
Back when he was a youngster—I guess he got the name Zoot with the Woody band?
If I recall the story, he was--I shouldn't try to say this, but somebody laid Zoot on him. His name is Jack, isn't it?
